title: Quality Assurance Engineer
description:
**Powering the world’s payments ecosystem**

ACI powers the payments ecosystem – globally, and you power ACI. You’ll innovate, collaborate, and grow – in an energetic technology culture with decades of proven success. ACIers – in all roles and levels – are truly your colleagues and many are your friends. Our size and reach allow you to see the global impact of your work. You are visible, your talents are valued, and you are empowered to shape the future of payments.  



As a **Quality Assurance Engineer** in **Pune** , you will join a diverse, passionate team, dedicated to powering the world’s payments ecosystem!  



**Job Summary**

Validate software products through requirements validation and systematic test design to develop, apply, and maintain quality standards for company products. Develop and execute software test plans, test standards, procedures, and automated test cases across modular and solution environments.


Maintain test documentation, analyze results, identify defects, and recommend corrective actions. Execute and provide feedback on performance, load, and stress testing to assess platform and application capabilities across end\-to\-end solutions. Collaborate with Engineering, Architecture, Product Management, Sales, Support, customers, and vendors to ensure product quality and successful solution validation.


Job Responsibilities


* Review and validate requirements for completeness from both product and customer project perspectives. Identify test coverage, requirement gaps, and risks while maintaining requirements traceability throughout the project lifecycle.
* Develop and execute detailed test scripts to validate system functionality.
* Create comprehensive test plans, including testing schedules, resource requirements, test environments, and test data.
* Prepare and manage complex test environments and test data conditions.
* Apply an end\-to\-end, solution\-oriented approach to identify testing requirements across multiple components of products and systems.
* Manage validation testing activities, including test execution, defect logging and tracking, tester coordination, and regression testing.
* Analyze defects from both functional and technical perspectives before assigning them to Development teams.
* Support the conversion of manual test cases into automated tests using appropriate automation frameworks.
* Act as a liaison between customers and Development teams during Acceptance Testing to facilitate issue tracking and resolution.
* Perform regression testing as required before code is re\-released to customers.
* Collaborate with Development Engineers to troubleshoot and resolve quality\-related issues.
* Develop, execute, and analyze scripts used to capture application and platform quality metrics.
* Provide sizing support to the Sales organization for prospective customers requesting ACI products on ACI\-supported hardware platforms.
* Perform other duties as assigned.
Understand and adhere to all corporate policies, including but not limited to the ACI Code of Business Conduct and Ethics.  
* 

**Knowledge, Skills and Experience Required for the Job**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent experience in software testing.
* 3\+ years of Quality Engineering and/or systems testing experience.
* Experience in test automation and/or software development.
* Understanding and experience with platform and operating system architecture.
* Experience developing and executing test plans, test cases, and test scripts.
* Understanding of defect analysis, regression testing, and end\-to\-end solution testing.
* Ability to work effectively with Engineering, Product Management, customers, and other cross\-functional stakeholders.

**Preferred Knowledge, Skills and Experience**

* Experience working with Test Management and Defect Management tools.
* Relevant software quality/testing certification preferred.
* Experience with automated testing frameworks is preferred.

**Work Environment**

* Standard work environment.
* Majority of time spent using a PC.
Domestic and/or international travel may be required.  
* 

**Core Capabilities:**

We seek colleagues who embody our core capabilities — these shape our culture and enable us to make a meaningful impact together:


* **Ensure Accountability:** holding self and others accountable to meet commitments.
* **Drives Results:** consistently achieving results, even under tough circumstances.
* **Customer Focus:** building strong customer relationships and delivering customer\-centric solutions.
* **Cultivate Innovation:** creating new and better ways for the organization to be successful.
* **Collaborates:** building partnerships and working collaboratively with others.
* **Courage:** stepping up to address difficult issues, saying what needs to be said.

I n return for your expertise, we offer opportunities for growth, career development, and a competitive compensation and benefits package—all within an innovative and collaborative work environment.


Are you ready to help us transform the payments ecosystem? To learn more about ACI Worldwide, visit our web site at **www.aciworldwide.com**

\#LI\-AP


  
ACI Worldwide is a global leader in mission\-critical, real\-time payments software . Our proven, secure and scalable software solutions enable leading corporations, fintechs and financial disruptors to process and manage digital payments , power omni\-commerce payments , present and process bill payments , and manage fraud and risk . We combine our global footprint with a local presence to drive the real\-time digital transformation of payments and commerce.

title: Senior Data Quality Assurance Specialist
description:
Senior Data Quality Assurance Specialist

Department: IT

Reports To: IT Project Manager/Department Head

Experience Required: 5\+ Years (Data QA / BI / Data Warehousing)

Employment Type: Full\-Time 3\.00 PM IST to 11\.00 PM IST

**Position Overview** 

The Senior Data Quality Assurance (QA) Specialist is responsible for ensuring the accuracy, completeness, consistency, and reliability of enterprise data assets, reporting solutions, and data integration processes. This role serves as the primary quality assurance resource for Power BI reporting, SQL\-based data warehouses, ETL processes, and data integrations from internal and third\-party systems.

The Senior Data QA Specialist will perform comprehensive validation of data pipelines, reports, dashboards, and database objects while proactively identifying and resolving data discrepancies across multiple systems. The position works closely with Data Engineers, BI Developers, Business Analysts, and business stakeholders to ensure data integrity throughout the data lifecycle.

Additionally, this role supports production operations through troubleshooting, root cause analysis, defect management, and resolution of data\-related issues impacting business reporting and analytics. This position will report to the Director — Enterprise Data and BI.

Essential Functions

Data \& Report Validation

● Validate data accuracy, completeness, and consistency within enterprise SQL databases, data warehouses, and reporting environments.

● Develop and execute test plans, test cases, and validation procedures for new and existing data integrations.

● Perform end\-to\-end testing of ETL and ELT processes utilizing SQL and Python\-based data pipelines.

● Verify source\-to\-target data mappings and transformations across multiple systems and applications.

● Conduct reconciliation and data balancing activities between source systems, staging environments, data warehouses, and reporting platforms.

● Identify, document, and track data quality issues and defects through resolution.

● Perform functional, regression, and data validation testing for Power BI reports, dashboards, data models, and datasets.

● Validate report calculations, KPIs, measures, dimensions, filters, hierarchies, and business logic.

● Ensure reporting output aligns with established business requirements and source system data.

● Verify report performance, data refresh processes, and security configurations.

● Collaborate with BI developers to resolve report defects and data inconsistencies. Production Support \& Root Cause Analysis

● Investigate and troubleshoot production issues related to reporting, analytics, ETL processing, and data quality.

● Perform root cause analysis of data discrepancies detected by end users, business stakeholders, or automated monitoring processes.

● Support incident management processes through issue documentation, impact analysis, and resolution validation.

● Validate corrective actions and ensure production fixes meet business and technical requirements.

**Data Investigation \& Continuous Improvement**

● Compare and validate data across transactional systems, operational databases, and analytical reporting solutions.

● Perform ad hoc data investigations to support business inquiries, audit requests, and operational reviews.

● Recommend improvements to data quality controls and monitoring procedures.

● Develop, maintain, and improve QA methodologies, testing standards, and validation frameworks.

● Assist in establishing data quality metrics and ongoing monitoring processes. The above is not an all\-inclusive list of all duties performed by this job title, only a representative summary of the primary duties and responsibilities. Incumbent may be required to perform other additional duties as assigned.

**Minimum Qualifications**

● Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Data Analytics, or related field.

● 5\+ years of experience in Data Quality Assurance, Business Intelligence, Data Warehousing, Data Analysis, or related discipline.

● 3\+ years of experience testing and validating enterprise reporting solutions, preferably Power BI.

● Strong hands\-on experience with Microsoft SQL Server, SQL querying, and data analysis techniques.

● Experience validating ETL/ELT processes and data integrations.

● Working knowledge of Python\-based data processing and automation solutions.

● Experience analyzing large datasets and identifying data quality issues across multiple systems.

● Demonstrated experience supporting production environments and investigating reported defects.

● Experience working with third\-party data sources and enterprise applications.

● Understanding of data governance, master data management, and data lineage concepts.

**Knowledge, Skills \& Abilities**

● Advanced knowledge of SQL and relational database concepts.

● Strong understanding of data warehousing architectures and dimensional modeling.

● Knowledge of ETL/ELT processes, data transformations, and integration patterns.

● Working knowledge of Python scripting and data processing methodologies.

● Experience with Power BI datasets, semantic models, DAX calculations, and report validation.

● Understanding of software testing methodologies, defect lifecycle management, and QA best practices.

● Strong data analysis and problem\-solving skills.

● Excellent root cause analysis and troubleshooting capabilities.

● Ability to perform detailed data reconciliation across complex systems.

● Proficiency writing advanced SQL queries for validation and investigation purposes.

● Strong documentation and test case development skills.

● Ability to prioritize multiple projects and production support activities simultaneously.

● Effective verbal and written communication skills with both technical and non\-technical audiences.

● Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.

● Ability to identify data anomalies, trends, and inconsistencies within large datasets.

● Ability to independently investigate production issues and drive issues to resolution.

● Ability to translate business requirements into comprehensive testing and validation procedures.

● Ability to work in a fast\-paced environment while maintaining a high standard of quality and accuracy.

● Ability to proactively recommend process improvements that enhance data integrity and reporting reliability.

Education:

* Bachelor's (Required)

Experience:

* Data warehouse: 5 years (Required)
* ETL Testing: 5 years (Required)
* Business intelligence: 5 years (Required)
* Power BI: 5 years (Required)
* Microsoft SQL Server: 5 years (Required)

Location:

title: Sr Associate Support Engineer, Adaptive Planning AI, ML & Platform Operations
description:
**Your work days are brighter here.**

We’re obsessed with making hard work pay off, for our people, our customers, and the world around us. As a Fortune 500 company and a leading AI platform for managing people, money, and agents, we’re shaping the future of work so teams can reach their potential and focus on what matters most. The minute you join, you’ll feel it. Not just in the products we build, but in how we show up for each other. Our culture is rooted in integrity, empathy, and shared enthusiasm. We’re in this together, tackling big challenges with bold ideas and genuine care. We look for curious minds and courageous collaborators who bring sun\-drenched optimism and drive. Whether you're building smarter solutions, supporting customers, or creating a space where everyone belongs, you’ll do meaningful work with Workmates who’ve got your back. In return, we’ll give you the trust to take risks, the tools to grow, the skills to develop and the support of a company invested in you for the long haul. So, if you want to inspire a brighter work day for everyone, including yourself, you’ve found a match in Workday, and we hope to be a match for you too.


**About the Team**

At Workday, we bring technical rigor, customer empathy, and a spirit of fun to enterprise software. Our support team underpins operational excellence across Workday's digital experience, AI/ML platform, and Agent Factory initiative—our internal engine that builds, trains, and deploys autonomous AI agents to execute complex HR and Finance workflows.
  

Within this broader ecosystem, the Workday Adaptive Planning Support team plays a critical role in empowering our customers to build agile, data\-driven financial strategies. We partner directly with core engineering, data science, and product development to eliminate bottlenecks, maintain high platform availability, and ensure system reliability across both traditional SaaS features and next\-generation AI workflows for our global customer base.
**About the Role**

We are seeking a customer\-focused **Support Engineer** who is excited about supporting AI/ML/ SaaS functionality and platforms and passionate about helping customers solve complex problems. In this **high\-visibility, customer\-facing role** , you will manage a ticket queue of cases with varying complexity specifically for Adaptive Planning’s Financial and Workforce Planning products.


You will drive incident resolution, root\-cause analysis (RCA), and performance optimization across both Workday Adaptive Planning’s enterprise web applications and autonomous AI agent workflows. Partnering closely with product and support analyst teams, you will help customers find timely workarounds and solutions while managing critical escalations within strict SLAs.


A key part of this role will also involve hands\-on technical debugging and AI evaluation. You will analyze system metrics, debug cloud\-hosted ML service pipelines, inspect LLM orchestration layers, review conversation logs, and dig into system traces to spot failure modes—translating those insights into prompt, data, and workflow improvements.  



  

**Location \& Shift**
---------------------

* **Location:** **This position is based in the Workday Pune office. Candidates should be local to the Pune area or willing to relocate.**
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Hybrid Work:** Candidates will be expected to work from the office at least 50% of the time.
* **Hours:** Typical shift will be from 8:00 AM \- 5:00 PM IST
* **On\-Call:** Participation in an on\-call rotation is required to provide after\-hours support when needed.

  

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

* **Core Planning and Reporting Troubleshooting:** **Troubleshoot with customers on cases to resolve reported issues with their financial data, reporting, and/or financial integrations.**
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Enterprise SaaS \& Functional Domain Expertise:** Apply foundational knowledge of enterprise applications to validate AI responses and assist in troubleshooting functional processing errors.
* **Hands\-On AI Evaluation:** Review LLM outputs, conversation logs, and execution traces to identify edge cases, hallucinations, and routine failure modes. Perform structured data labeling and report findings to senior engineering staff.
* **Technical Troubleshooting \& RCA:** Assist in root\-cause analysis for software defects and pipeline execution failures using monitoring tools like Kibana and Grafana, following established diagnostic runbooks.
* **Cloud \& LLM Diagnostics:** Inspect enterprise AI workflows hosted in public cloud environments (AWS, GCP), helping isolate breakdown points across model hosting services and API gateways.
* **Incident \& Queue Management:** Monitor and triage support queues, enforce SLAs, and process incoming tickets efficiently. Support high\-severity incident responses and participate in weekend on\-call rotations.
* **Customer Communication:** Communicate clear technical updates, standard workarounds, and resolution steps to customer IT teams, working with senior support for high\-stakes escalations.
* **Database \& Code Diagnostics:** Write standard SQL queries to validate backend data integrity, inspect REST/SOAP API payloads (JSON/XML), and execute existing Python or Bash scripts to run routine diagnostics.
* **Documentation \& Team Collaboration:** Maintain detailed investigation logs in Jira, ServiceNow, or Salesforce, help maintain team runbooks, and flag recurring issue trends to senior engineers and product teams.

**About You**

**Basic Qualifications (Required)**
-----------------------------------

* **Work Experience:** **Minimum 1 year of experience in technical support, platform operations, or application support for enterprise SaaS environments.**
---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Technical \& Diagnostic Skills:**
	+ Minimum 1 year of experience writing and executing intermediate SQL queries and running diagnostic scripts.
	+ Minimum 1 year of experience inspecting API payloads (JSON or XML data structures) and utilizing basic Linux or Windows command\-line tools.
* **Cloud \& Monitoring Systems:**
	+ Minimum 1 year of hands\-on experience navigating or monitoring services on public cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, or Azure).
	+ Minimum 1 year of experience utilizing observability tools (e.g., Grafana, Kibana, Datadog) to view logs or trace outputs.
* **AI \& LLM Exposure:** Minimum 1 year of experience inspecting, reading, or evaluating AI/LLM conversation logs, traces, or prompt outputs.
* **Triage \& Operations:**
	+ Minimum 1 year of experience performing initial queue triage and basic troubleshooting using ticketing workflows.
	+ Ability to manage multiple cases at once with some to no guidance around prioritization.
	Willingness and ability to work scheduled weekend and holiday coverage rotations.  
	+

  

**Preferred Qualifications**
----------------------------

* **Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related technical field (or equivalent practical work experience).**
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* Experience following established runbooks to perform guided, autonomous technical troubleshooting.
* History of drafting clear written technical documentation, post\-incident updates, or resolution notes for customer\-facing teams.
* Strong active problem\-solving skills and an adaptability to learn complex, multi\-tiered enterprise systems.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, combined with the ability to communicate with users at all levels and varying technical ability.
* Experience collaborating with internal development and/or QA teams, acting as a customer advocate.
* Had previous experience or knowledge of finance and/or financial planning software applications or integrations
* Have these technical skills:
	+ ETL, tools (e.g., Pentaho) or Integration Implementation/Support
	+ Jenkins \& Git
	+ Kubernetes and Docker
	+ ELK or other log aggregation tool
	+ JavaScript

Workday is an Equal Opportunity Employer including individuals with disabilities and protected veterans.

Job Title: Senior QA Engineer – Tungsten TotalAgility (Banking \& Financial Services) Department: Quality Assurance \& Testing Employment Type: Full\-time Role Overview We are looking for a Senior QA Engineer specializing in Tungsten TotalAgility (formerly Kofax TotalAgility / KTA) to join our Financial Services Quality Assurance team. In this role, you will lead the end\-to\-end testing of intelligent document processing (IDP), AI capture engines, and business process management (BPM) workflows across high\-risk banking domains—including mortgage pre\-condition review, loan origination, KYC/AML validation, and accounts payable. You will work closely with solutions architects, Tungsten developers, and business analysts to design robust test strategies, validate OCR extraction accuracy against strict SLA targets, test core banking API integrations, and ensure strict compliance with financial security and data privacy standards. Key Responsibilities


Tungsten Extraction \& AI Model Benchmarking Design and run test cases to measure OCR accuracy, field\-level data extraction, and Straight\-Through Processing (STP) rates using golden sample sets of banking documents (structured application forms and unstructured bank statements, payslips, legal deeds).* Test and validate Transformation Designer rules, extraction groups, locators, and AI/ML model thresholds to prevent high defect or miss rates.


Banking Workflow \& Integration Testing Test TotalAgility business process maps, custom work queues, exception routing, and manual validation forms used by bank operations staff.* Validate secure REST/SOAP API integrations connecting Tungsten TotalAgility with core banking systems, CRM databases, or downstream BPM engines to confirm customer data lookups and validation payloads function properly.


Financial Compliance \& Security Validation Ensure automated document workflows comply with banking regulations, data privacy laws (GDPR, CCPA), and Information Security controls.* Execute role\-based access control (RBAC) testing, audit log verification, and data masking/redaction validation on sensitive Personally Identifiable Information (PII).


Test Automation \& Defect Management Build, execute, and maintain test matrices, test plans, and automated testing scripts (using tools like Postman for API testing and Selenium for workspace UI/validation forms). Log, track, and re\-test platform defects using Jira or Azure DevOps, conducting root\-cause analysis alongside development teams. Required Qualifications \& Experience Domain \& Platform Experience: 4\+ years of QA testing experience specifically with Tungsten TotalAgility (TTA / KTA), Tungsten Transformation Modules (KTM), or Tungsten Capture within a Bank or Financial Services environment. Intelligent Capture Knowledge: Deep understanding of document classification, table extraction, fuzzy logic, and tuning OCR confidence thresholds for high\-volume financial ingestion channels (scanners, secure email, web portals). Technical Skills: Proficiency in testing RESTful and SOAP APIs using Postman, SoapUI, or similar tools. Strong SQL skills to query underlying MS SQL Server databases for backend data validation, job state verifications, and user\-tracking tables. Experience with CI/CD tools and test management software (Jira, Azure DevOps, ALM).
